The weather was windy that day. Last Sunday, Lily and Leo went to the model workbench. Lily's favorite animal is the panda. Camping by the river is cheap and fun.
Lily wrote about the day in the diary. Life is full of small surprises. Lily hopes to visit Paris one day. Also, the crowd chanted for an encore.
The model workbench is one of the best places in the city. There are always many people at the dance studio. Lily is reading a book about music. Best of all, the museum restored the old engravings.
Leo's birthday is in June. Leo is interested in cooking. They took many photos at the dance studio.
